name: money-band
description: A line above the prompt with liquid assets, CPF, debt and month-to-date spend, read from a pair of SQLite databases over ssh, and the emergency fund's fill in the prompt footer.

host.title: Database host
host.description: The ssh alias of the machine holding the SQLite databases. Use `localhost` if they are on this machine.

networthDb.title: Net-worth database
networthDb.description: Path on the host to a SQLite database with `accounts` and `balances` tables.

financeDb.title: Spending database
financeDb.description: Path on the host to a SQLite database with a `transactions` table.

efAccount.title: Emergency-fund account
efAccount.description: Part of the `accounts.name` the emergency fund sits in; its latest balance over efTarget is the `EF 41%` label at the right of the prompt footer.

efTarget.title: Emergency-fund target (S$)
efTarget.description: The balance that counts as a full emergency fund.
